method_card.title: Mental Wellbeing and Healthy Living
method_card.content:
This lesson (Higher tier) covers vocabulary for emotions, stress, sleep and mental balance. You will use estar + adjective for all feelings, the reflexive verb sentirse, and the present subjunctive after impersonal expressions.

SpanishEnglish
el bienestarwellbeing
el estrésstress
la ansiedadanxiety
sentirseto feel (reflexive)
estar estresado/ato be stressed
estar cansado/ato be tired
estar contento/ato be happy
el equilibriobalance
el sueño / dormirsleep / to sleep
relajarseto relax
el consejero escolar / la consejera escolarschool counsellor
es importante que + subjunctiveit is important that...
es necesario que + subjunctiveit is necessary that...
florecer (Higher)to flourish / to thrive

Grammar focus — estar for emotions: Emotions and feelings ALWAYS use estar, never ser. Estoy estresado (I am stressed — temporary state), está contenta (she is happy). Writing soy estresado is a serious error — stress is not a permanent identity.

Grammar focus — present subjunctive after impersonal expressions (Higher): After es importante que and es necesario que, use the present subjunctive. Regular -ar verbs: drop the -o of the yo form and add -e endings (hablar → hable, hablen). Regular -er/-ir verbs: add -a endings (comer → coma; dormir → duerma). Example: Es importante que duermas bien (It is important that you sleep well).

Model: A veces me siento estresado porque tengo muchos exámenes. Es importante que haya un buen equilibrio entre el estudio y el descanso. Si me siento agobiado, hablo con el consejero escolar porque siempre me ayuda. (Sometimes I feel stressed because I have lots of exams. It is important that there is a good balance between study and rest. If I feel overwhelmed, I talk to the school counsellor because they always help me.)
steps: Learn wellbeing vocabulary — all emotions use estar, never ser
Master sentirse + adjective for expressing how you feel
Practice the present subjunctive after es importante que and es necesario que
Build opinions about mental health using creo que, en mi opinión, and hay que

exam_context.frequency: Higher-tier topic — mental wellbeing and opinion language rewarded in extended writing and speaking

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: Me siento muy estresado porque tengo muchos exámenes.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Me siento = I feel. This is the reflexive verb sentirse.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: estresado = stressed (estar adjective — temporary feeling). porque = because. muchos exámenes = lots of exams.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I feel very stressed because I have lots of exams.

worked_examples.question: Spot the error: Soy muy cansado y tengo estrés.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Tiredness is a temporary state — not a permanent identity. Ask: is this how you feel right now, or is it a fixed trait?

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Soy is from ser (permanent identity). For feelings and temporary states, you must use estar.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: The error is Soy — it should be Estoy muy cansado. Emotions and physical states always use estar, not ser.

worked_examples.question: Complete with the subjunctive: 'Es importante que ___ (dormir/tú) ocho horas.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: After es importante que, the next verb must be in the present subjunctive.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Dormir is a stem-changing verb (o→ue). For the subjunctive tú form: start from the yo present tense duermo, remove the -o, then add the -ar ending -es (because -ir verbs take -a/-as/-a endings in the subjunctive): duermas.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Es importante que duermas ocho horas. — It is important that you sleep eight hours.

bronze.question: Match the Spanish wellbeing words to their English meaning
Match the Spanish emotion phrases to their English meaning

pairs.right: to be in a good mood

bronze.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: muy estresado porque tengo muchos deberes.

gaps.correct_explain: Estoy is from estar. Feelings and temporary states always use estar, never ser.

wrong.Soy: Soy is from ser — used for permanent identity. Stress is a temporary feeling → estoy.
wrong.Tengo: Tengo means 'I have'. You need the verb 'to be' for an adjective → estoy.

gaps.correct_explain: Por here introduces a reason/consequence: 'therefore'. Por eso (because of this) also works.

wrong.Para: Para expresses purpose or destination. For a reason/consequence, use por or por eso.

bronze.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: bien para mantener el bienestar mental. No se debe ignorar el

gaps.correct_explain: dormir is the infinitive. After es importante (followed directly, without que), use the infinitive.

wrong.duerme: duerme is conjugated. After es importante + no subject, use the infinitive → dormir.
wrong.duermo: duermo is the yo present tense. Use the infinitive → dormir.

gaps.correct_explain: estrés = stress. Note the accent on the é — it is a masculine noun: el estrés.

wrong.equilibrio: equilibrio means 'balance' — the sentence is about not ignoring stress → estrés.

bronze.question: What does 'Me siento agobiada por los exámenes' mean?
options: I feel overwhelmed by the exams
I feel excited about the exams
I felt overwhelmed by the exams
The exams make me feel better

bronze.question: Which sentence correctly uses estar for a feeling?

bronze.source_text: Para mantener el bienestar mental, hay que dormir bien y hablar con alguien de confianza.
model_answers: To maintain mental wellbeing, one must sleep well and talk to someone you trust.

silver.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: agobiado cuando tengo mucho trabajo. Por eso es importante que
silver.english: Sometimes I feel overwhelmed when I have lots of work. That is why it is important to maintain a good balance.

gaps.correct_explain: siento is the yo form of sentirse. The stem changes e→ie: siento, sientes, siente, sentimos, sentís, sienten.

wrong.siente: siente is the él/ella form. The subject is 'I' → siento.
wrong.sentir: sentir is the infinitive. You need the conjugated yo form → siento.

gaps.rule: Present subjunctive after es importante que
gaps.correct_explain: haya is the present subjunctive of hay (haber). After es importante que, the subjunctive is required.

wrong.hay: hay is indicative. After es importante que, use the subjunctive → haya.
wrong.había: había is the imperfect indicative. The present subjunctive is needed after es importante que → haya.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Mi amiga soy muy ansiosa antes de los exámenes.
silver.explanation: Anxiety before exams is a temporary state, so estar is required. Mi amiga está muy ansiosa. Additionally, soy is first-person (I am), but the subject is mi amiga (she) → está.
silver.translation: My friend is very anxious before exams.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: It is important to look after your mental health.

distractor_labels.cuidas: wrong form — after es importante (no que), use the infinitive cuidar, not the conjugated form cuidas

silver.source_text: I feel stressed before exams. I think it is important to sleep well and to talk to a friend.
model_answers: Me siento estresado antes de los exámenes. Creo que es importante dormir bien y hablar con un amigo.

gold.source_text: Sometimes I feel very stressed because I have too much work and not enough sleep. In my opinion, it is important that young people talk to someone they trust, for example a school counsellor. I think that looking after your mental health is just as important as physical health.
model_answers: A veces me siento muy estresado porque tengo demasiado trabajo y duermo poco. En mi opinión, es importante que los jóvenes hablen con alguien de confianza, por ejemplo el consejero escolar. Creo que cuidar la salud mental es igual de importante que la salud física.
gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking a Higher-tier translation about mental wellbeing. Source: '{source}'. Model answer: '{model}'. Accept any grammatically correct translation. Check: estar not ser for feelings, sentirse (reflexive), present subjunctive after es importante que (hablen — not hablan), creo que + indicative, igual de importante que. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"2-3 sentences","improvement":"optional correction"}

gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: It is necessary that you sleep at least eight hours to look after your wellbeing.

distractor_labels.duermes: wrong mood — after es necesario que, use the present subjunctive duermas, not the indicative duermes
distractor_labels.dormir: wrong form — after es necesario que (with que), you need the subjunctive duermas, not the infinitive dormir
distractor_labels.seas: wrong verb — you need dormir (to sleep) in the subjunctive, not ser

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a leisure centre in Spain talking to a wellness advisor about how to manage stress and stay mentally healthy.

bullets.prompt: Explain how you feel at the moment and why.
bullets.model_answer: Me siento bastante estresado últimamente porque tengo muchos exámenes y poco tiempo libre.
bullets.note: estar not ser for stress; sentirse (reflexive); porque + reason

bullets.prompt: Say what you do to relax and look after your wellbeing.
bullets.model_answer: Para relajarme, escucho música y salgo a pasear. También intento dormir ocho horas.
bullets.note: para + infinitive relajarme; present tense routine; intento + infinitive

bullets.prompt: Say what you think is important for good mental health.
bullets.model_answer: Creo que es importante que haya un buen equilibrio entre el trabajo y el descanso.
bullets.note: creo que + es importante que + subjunctive haya

bullets.prompt: Ask the advisor what you should do if you feel very overwhelmed.
bullets.model_answer: ¿Qué debería hacer si me siento muy agobiado?
bullets.note: conditional debería; si + present indicative (not subjunctive); me siento (reflexive)

gold.question: Write 40-50 words in Spanish about mental wellbeing. Include: how you feel at the moment and why, what you do to look after your mental health, what you think is important for wellbeing, and who you would talk to if you felt very stressed.
gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking Higher-tier extended writing about mental wellbeing. Mark on: Communication (all bullet points addressed?), Range of language (estar for emotions, sentirse, opinion structures creo que / en mi opinión, present subjunctive after es importante que if attempted, variety of tenses), Accuracy (estar not ser for feelings, reflexive pronoun on sentirse, subjunctive after es importante que). The response must use a factual, supportive tone — acknowledging that asking for help, including from a school counsellor, is a positive and sensible approach. Be encouraging and formative. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"3-4 sentences covering each criterion","improvement":"One specific grammar point to work on"}

gold.question: Listen and type what you hear
gold.audio_text: Es importante que los jóvenes hablen con alguien de confianza cuando se sienten agobiados. El consejero escolar puede ayudar.
gold.correct_text: Es importante que los jóvenes hablen con alguien de confianza cuando se sienten agobiados. El consejero escolar puede ayudar.
gold.translation: It is important that young people talk to someone they trust when they feel overwhelmed. The school counsellor can help.

gold.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: bien para florecer. También es importante que no
gold.english: It is necessary that you sleep well in order to flourish. It is also important that you do not ignore the stress.

gaps.rule: Present subjunctive after es necesario que — dormir
gaps.correct_explain: duermas is the tú form of the present subjunctive of dormir. Stem change o→ue applies in the subjunctive too: duerme → remove -o, add -as → duermas.

wrong.duermes: duermes is the indicative (fact). After es necesario que, use the subjunctive → duermas.
wrong.dormir: dormir is the infinitive. After es necesario que (with que), the subjunctive is required → duermas.

gaps.rule: Present subjunctive after es importante que — ignorar
gaps.correct_explain: ignores is the present subjunctive of ignorar (yo form ignoro → remove -o → ignor- → add -es for tú).

wrong.ignorar: ignorar is the infinitive. After es importante que, use the subjunctive → ignores.
wrong.ignoras: ignoras is the indicative tú form. After es importante que, you need the subjunctive → ignores.
